description: This file implements the DeviceHandler class for WebRTC device management, including registration, message handling, and client communication within the WebRTC operator component of the project.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Handles WebRTC device signaling, registration, message forwarding, and client communication.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of DeviceHandler.

methods.name: OnClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the device connection is closed.

methods.name: RegisterClient
methods.description: Registers a new client handler and returns the total number of clients.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages based on their type.

methods.name: SendClientMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific client.
